measurement_method: full-run FPS = (total frames - 1) / elapsed wall time between first and last paint events
input_event_recording_method: One canonical record per spontaneous QWindow ingress; all Qt target deliveries are retained separately. Qt does not expose portable native-action identity.
acceptance_note: Performance measurements are reported independently. Eligibility is finalized only for a requested one-hour 1x run and after full duration, FPS, input provenance, unambiguous event recording, storage, execution, cleanup, and worker-exit checks.
